The formal vote journey

A trusted vote has a process behind it.

A ballot alone does not make a formal vote trustworthy. The people, preparation, procedure, and record around it all have to be clear.

  1. 01

    Give members access early.

    Open the voting portal in the days before the formal vote, with a practice vote that lets members get comfortable before the voting window begins.

  2. 02

    Prepare the electorate.

    Confirm eligibility, credentials, weighting, and who can participate before the meeting moves to a vote.

  3. 03

    Run the decision clearly.

    Keep quorum, motions, amendments, and participation connected to the formal meeting as the vote unfolds.

  4. 04

    Close with a record ready to use.

    Finish with a clear outcome and an audit trail leadership can act on after the vote closes.

The ballot

The member’s moment of decision.

A ballot should make the choice clear, the safeguards visible, and the next step obvious on any device.

  • Secure & encrypted — every ballot signed and captured, not guessed.
  • Eligibility & credentialing — only verified members vote, once.
  • Roll-call & weighted voting — for delegates, locals, and shares.
  • Review before submit — abstain, change, and confirm with confidence.
  • Accessible — readable, keyboard-friendly, built for every member.

In the room, remote, or hybrid

Wherever your members are.

Run the same trusted vote in person, fully remote, or hybrid — on any device, from one link.

  • Zoom-integrated — Zoom handles the video. DOTS Connect handles the meeting.
  • Any device — phone, tablet, or laptop, with no app or download.
  • In-room ready — pair with RF clickers when the room calls for it.
  • Live progress — quorum and turnout visible as the vote runs.
